description: Defines Vulkan format utilities, structures, and classes for ANGLE's Vulkan backend, including format descriptions, support checks, and format tables.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Describes a Vulkan format, including format IDs, VkFormat values, and initialization methods.

classes.name: FormatTable
classes.description: Stores and manages a table of Format objects indexed by angle::FormatID.

methods.name: valid()
methods.description: Checks if the internalFormat is valid (non-zero).

methods.name: intendedFormat()
methods.description: Returns the front-end format associated with the intendedFormatID.

methods.name: actualImageFormat()
methods.description: Returns the actual image format associated with actualImageFormatID.

methods.name: actualBufferFormat()
methods.description: Returns the actual buffer format associated with actualBufferFormatID.

methods.name: getInternalFormatInfo()
methods.description: Retrieves internal format info for a given GLenum type.

methods.name: initialize()
methods.description: Initializes the Format object with renderer and angle format.

methods.name: initialize()
methods.description: Initializes the format table with renderer info and texture caps.
